name: fix-kalide-template-source
body: source: system body said decks are validated 'against built-in EY templates'; inconsistency: the project replaces built-ins with a project-local reusable `templates/` library (feedback-1); resolution: body reworded to validate against the project's own `templates/` library, no built-ins, no EY reference [with user]. (Renamed from solution.note.fix-eypres-template-source in the kalide rename; now details solution.system.kalide.)
